name: The One-Horned Billy
summary: The one-horned billy goat in Krezk's pens belongs to nobody, because nobody is brave enough. He turned up last spring, already grown, with a ring on his horn.

stages.journal: Stelian the goatherd says the one-horned billy in Krezk's pens turned up last spring already grown, with a woman's silver ring jammed down on his one horn. Nobody's been brave enough to take it off.
objectives: Have a look at the billy in Krezk's goat pens
stages.hint: Go to the goat pens in Krezk and have a look at the one-horned billy.

stages.journal: The one-horned billy guards the gap in Krezk's pens, with a thin silver ring jammed down on his horn.
objectives: Get close enough to see the ring, or look the goat in the eye
stages.hint: At Krezk's pens, get close enough to read the ring on the billy's horn (Animal Handling), look him in the eye (Insight), or speak with him by spell.

stages.journal: Inside the ring on the billy's horn: D. AND V. BEREZ. And behind the goat's square eyes there's a man, begging. Somebody did this to him.
objectives: Lift the curse: Remove Curse, or a scroll of it
stages.hint: Lift the curse on the billy with Remove Curse or a scroll of it. The ring's engraving points to Berez.

stages.journal: The billy is Dragos, the ferryman of Berez. Baba Lysaga turned him into a goat for refusing to row her across the river. His wife Vera she kept, and stitched into the Rag Queen, a scarecrow she made from the dresses of every drowned bride of Berez. It walks the scarecrow field by her stump, whether she's there or not.
objectives: Burn the Rag Queen in Berez's scarecrow field
stages.hint: Go to the scarecrow field in the Ruins of Berez and burn the Rag Queen.

stages.journal: The Rag Queen is a heap of burned silk and straw in the scarecrow field at Berez, and whatever was stitched into her is out.
stages.hint: Go back to Krezk and tell Dragos.

stages.journal: Dragos felt it when the Rag Queen burned: like a hand taking hold of his, and letting go. He gave us everything that was stitched into her, the drowned brides' dowries and a sword Lysaga stole from a knight.
